Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Kavita - 38 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Aditya - 9 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Aditya stand near him.]

Aditya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rishabh jumps with joy.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

[Rishabh tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya: "Aunty, look at this."

[Rishabh takes the bag from Mother.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Rishabh starts crying.]

Aditya (softly): "That's great!"

[Rishabh trips over a stone.]

Aditya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Kavita: "Exactly right."

[A shard of glass cuts Rishabh's foot and blood flows.]

Aditya: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Rishabh: "So, here we are!"

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Rishabh: "Hmm, I see."

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Kavita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
